command.shareFile: Lesson: show this file to the class
command.checkpoint: Lesson: checkpoint (current code is the reference)
config.serverUrl: Game server URL. The default is the free public CodeArena server. Change it only if your school runs its own server (see the [README](https://github.com/q-werty452/codearena#self-hosting)).
config.ai.model: Gemini model for task generation, e.g. `gemini-3.6-flash`. Empty — pick the newest stable *flash* model available to your key automatically.
config.ai.endpoint: Gemini API base URL. Empty — `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`. Change only for a proxy.
description: Kahoot + Codewars inside VS Code: tug of war, quiz, Codewars, race and find-the-bug games for programming lessons.
